comparison.objective: Open a can using a hand-held rotary opener.
comparison.physical_skill: Maintain a bimanual clamp while repeatedly regrasping and turning a key around the rim.
comparison.success_condition: Lid cut completely around; can remains upright; opener removed, set down, and released.
comparison.reason: This tests sustained clamping plus cyclic rotary regrasping. The candidate instead tests linear sliding while continuously preserving a precision support interface and ball containment.
